definitions.explanation: payment calculated and typically paid on a per-day basis

examples.japanese: {日給|にっきゅう}は1{万|まん}{円|えん}です。
このアルバイトは{日給|にっきゅう}{制|せい}ですか。
examples.english: Is this part-time job paid on a daily basis?

examples.japanese: {日給|にっきゅう}で{働|はたら}いているので、{休|やす}むと{収入|しゅうにゅう}が{減|へ}る。
examples.english: Since I'm paid daily, my income decreases when I take days off.

notes:
{日給|にっきゅう} refers to wages paid on a daily basis, common for part-time or temporary work.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {日|にち} (day)
- {給|きゅう} (salary, wage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日給|にっきゅう}{制|せい} (daily wage system)
- {日給|にっきゅう}{月給|げっきゅう}{制|せい} (daily rate paid monthly)
- {日給|にっきゅう}で{払|はら}う (to pay daily)

RELATED WAGE TYPES:
- {時給|じきゅう} (hourly wage)
- {月給|げっきゅう} (monthly salary)
- {年俸|ねんぽう} (annual salary)
- {週給|しゅうきゅう} (weekly wage)

USAGE CONTEXT:
- Common for construction workers, event staff, temporary jobs
- Often seen in job listings as "{日給|にっきゅう}○○{円|えん}"
